bugs.error_message: Type error: Property 'subtotal' does not exist on type 'Cart & { __applicationErrorsType?: GetCurrentCartApplicationErrors | undefined; }'.
bugs.root_cause: The raw getCurrentCart() response from @wix/ecom does NOT have a top-level `subtotal` field. That `subtotal` property exists on the higher-level @wix/headless-ecom Cart abstraction (a wrapper component library), NOT the bare cart object returned by currentCart.getCurrentCart().
bugs.fix: Compute subtotal client-side from line items: `lineItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + parseFloat(item.price?.amount ?? '0') * (item.quantity ?? 0), 0)`, then format with `new Intl.NumberFormat('en-NZ', { style: 'currency', currency: cart?.currency ?? 'NZD' })`.

bugs.error_message: Vercel deployment Blocked: 'commit author does not have contributing access. Hobby teams do not support collaboration.'
bugs.root_cause: Vercel Hobby plan rejects deploys whose commit author email doesn't match the project owner's GitHub verified email. Commits were authored via `git -c user.email="<plain email>"` which Vercel sees as a different author.
bugs.fix: Rewrite all commits using GitHub no-reply email pattern: `git filter-branch -f --env-filter 'export GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="<userId>+<username>@users.noreply.github.com"; export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="..."; export GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=...; export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=...' -- --all` then `git push --force origin main`. Get userId via `gh api users/<username> --jq .id`. Also made repo public (Hobby requires public OR matching author).

bugs.error_message: Cart add silently succeeds (200 OK) but lineItems=0 — cart stays empty.
bugs.root_cause: Used wrong WIX_STORES_APP_ID constant `1380b703-ce81-ff05-f115-39571d94dfcd` (outdated). Wix silently ignores requests with unknown appIds — no error thrown.
bugs.fix: Use correct app ID `215238eb-22a5-4c36-9e7b-e7c08025e04e` (confirmed from CatalogReference JSDoc in @wix/auto_sdk_ecom_current-cart types). Also for products with manageVariants: include `options.variantId` in catalogReference (not options.options name/value map).

bugs.error_message: Mobile nav and cart drawer panels appear transparent on phone — menu items visible but no panel background.
bugs.root_cause: Both panels rendered inside <Header> which has position:sticky + z-index:30 creating a stacking context. Even with z-index:60+ on the aside, page content paints over because z-index only competes within the same stacking context. Tailwind class `bg-onyx` was being correctly applied but visually trapped.
bugs.fix: Use `createPortal(panel, document.body)` to render panels at document root, escaping all parent stacking contexts. Also moved critical styles inline (backgroundColor, position, z-index, borders) to avoid CSS load order issues.

bugs.error_message: Wix-hosted checkout redirect to https://www.corvoathletic.com/_api/iam/... → 'site can't be reached'.
bugs.root_cause: After DNS swap (www→Vercel, root→Wix), Wix's checkout flow generates URLs at the site's primary domain (corvoathletic.com root), which auto 301-redirects to www. www now serves Vercel which doesn't have Wix's /_api or /__ecom paths.
bugs.fix: Architectural pivot to Option B (Stripe custom checkout). Wix-hosted checkout fundamentally incompatible with the www→Vercel setup we want. Built /checkout page with Stripe PaymentElement, server actions for PaymentIntent + Wix Order creation.

bugs.error_message: Vercel build TypeScript error: Type '"2025-08-27.basil"' is not assignable to type '"2026-04-22.dahlia"'.
bugs.root_cause: Stripe Node SDK v22.x types pin apiVersion to the latest version at SDK build time. Used outdated version string.

bugs.error_message: Couldn't start checkout — 'An error occurred in the Server Components render. The specific message is omitted in production builds to avoid leaking sensitive details.' Underlying: StripeConnectionError thrown by stripe.paymentIntents.create on every checkout attempt.
bugs.root_cause: Chain of THREE separate issues under one opaque error: (1) Vercel 'Redeploy' reuses the cached build artifact — newly-added env vars never reached the function bundle. (2) Even after clean rebuild, Stripe SDK kept throwing StripeConnectionError — Next.js production server-action boundary masked it as 'An error occurred with...'. (3) ROOT CAUSE: the value stored in Vercel's STRIPE_SECRET_KEY had a different byte-length than the clean key (107 chars for sk_test_*). Paste from clipboard introduced invisible characters (zero-width space U+200B / non-breaking space U+00A0 / soft hyphen U+00AD). undici (Node 24 fetch impl) rejects HTTP headers containing such chars and Stripe SDK wraps the resulting TypeError as ConnectionError WITHOUT an HTTP response — indistinguishable from genuine network failure. .trim() does NOT strip these characters.
bugs.fix: Three layers: (a) ALWAYS force a clean rebuild via `git commit --allow-empty -m '...'` after changing env vars — Vercel's 'Redeploy' button reuses the cached build. (b) src/lib/stripe.ts: defensively `rawKey.trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')` AND `httpClient: Stripe.createFetchHttpClient()` (Stripe's recommendation for serverless / Node 24). (c) Delete the corrupted env var in Vercel UI, re-paste from a fresh copy in Stripe dashboard. Verification recipe: log `kLen=${rawKey.length} kTrLen=${trimKey.length}` — clean sk_test_ is exactly 107 chars; ALSO run a sanity `fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges')` from the same function to rule out genuine network issues (expect 401 = reachable). Resolved 2026-05-16; first successful PaymentIntent created at 06:26 UTC.

bugs.error_message: Wix order sync silently failed after Stripe payment captured. /thank-you rendered with synthetic order ID; Wix Sales->Orders showed nothing. Chain: (1) WIX_ORDER_FAIL Headers.appe... (invisible-char corruption in WIX_ADMIN_API_KEY paste), (2) after key fix: HTTP 400 'Validation failed: order.lineItem.taxInfo | order.lineItem.taxDetails -- Either ... must be defined.'
bugs.root_cause: Three layered issues. (1) WIX_ADMIN_API_KEY in Vercel UI contained invisible chars (zero-width space / NBSP / soft hyphen) -- same paste-corruption pattern as STRIPE_SECRET_KEY earlier. undici threw TypeError: Headers.append: Invalid header value before the request left the function. (2) Initial Wix payload was minimal -- missing top-level order.currency, per-line productName.original, price + lineItemPrice with amount/formattedAmount, itemType.preset, paymentOption, and a complete priceSummary (only had total). (3) The subtle one: each lineItem requires taxInfo (or taxDetails) EVEN WHEN TAX IS ZERO -- without it, Wix returns HTTP 400 validation error.
bugs.fix: Three layers. (a) trim()+dequote defense applied to WIX_ADMIN_API_KEY + WIX_SITE_ID in createWixOrder (same shape as src/lib/stripe.ts). Best ultimate fix: user generated a fresh API key in Wix dashboard (manage.wix.com -> Settings -> Headless Settings -> API Keys -> grant Wix Stores: Manage Orders + Read Products), copied via Wix's copy button, re-pasted in Vercel. (b) Enriched payload: re-fetch products server-side to populate authoritative name/price for each line; build all required fields with .toFixed(2) string amounts and Intl.NumberFormat('en-NZ') formattedAmount. (c) Each lineItem now includes taxInfo: { taxableAmount: <lineTotal>, taxAmount: '0.00', taxRate: '0', taxIncludedInPrice: false }. Diagnostic pattern that saved cycles: replayed production payload against Wix Orders API via local curl -- got the FULL validation error in one shot instead of waiting for next deploy cycle. Verified end-to-end: real order showed up in Wix Sales -> Orders at 06:54 UTC.
